value.quote: voters are given the opportunity to strategically choose their ballots
value.note: Main results: a robustness theorem for cycles of heuristic-driven polling dynamics, and examples of bad cycles. Section 4.3 adds a simulation study on synthetic cultures. Dynamical equilibria are fixed points of a dynamics, not game equilibria, so EQ is not coded.

C1.reason: The paper says its equilibria are fixed points of a heuristic dynamics, never Nash equilibria, so they are not equilibria of a game under EQ, and strategic ballot choice is the dominant theme.

value.quote: representing the way voters of this type choose their next ballot
value.note: All analyses model voters choosing ballots through outcome-dependent heuristics.

C3.1.reason: In every analysis the ballot is chosen by an outcome-dependent heuristic and differs from the held preference order; the paper notes strategic voting occurs even when ballots are restricted to sincere ones.
